module Gopurs.ModuleBindings
  ( TcoBindingGroup
  , prepare
  , declarations
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (fromArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, TranslateExpr, wrapInStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoType(..), sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (adtPayloadTypes, boxGoExpr, getUnboxedADT)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.ModuleWorkers as ModuleWorkers
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.NativeRecordArgs (workerArguments)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Typed))

type TcoBindingGroup =
  { recursive :: Boolean
  , bindings :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr)
  }

-- Analyze recursion before publishing the native signatures used by calls.
prepare :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> BackendModule -> { bindings :: Array TcoBindingGroup, functions :: ModuleFunctions }
prepare metadata modNameStr mod =
  let
    Tuple _ tcoBindings = foldl
      ( \(Tuple env acc) group ->
          let
            neBindings = fromArray group.bindings

            env' = case neBindings of
              Just ne | group.recursive -> Tco.topLevelTcoEnvGroup mod.name ne <> env
              _ -> env
            tcoBinds = map
              (\(Tuple id val) -> Tuple id (Tco.analyze env' val))
              group.bindings
          in
            Tuple env' (Array.snoc acc { recursive: group.recursive, bindings: tcoBinds })
      )
      (Tuple [] [])
      mod.bindings

    moduleFunctions :: ModuleFunctions
    moduleFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      ( \group ->
          if group.recursive then
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple _ val) -> extractUncurriedAbs val) group.bindings
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just _ -> map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
                Nothing -> map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (boxedSignature modNameStr name)) group.bindings
          else
            map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
      )
      tcoBindings
  in
    { bindings: tcoBindings, functions: moduleFunctions }

boxedSignature :: String -> String -> FunctionInfo
boxedSignature modNameStr name =
  { reference: SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)), fArgs: [], fRet: TypeValue, arity: 0 }

-- Syntax fixes worker arity. A computation between lambdas leaves a boxed
-- function result; fully consumed native sums use their specialized ABI.
-- Read-only record projections are selected here and reused by ModuleWorkers.
bindingSignature :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> Tuple Ident TcoExpr -> Tuple String FunctionInfo
bindingSignature metadata modNameStr (Tuple (Ident name) value) =
  let
    fallback = boxedSignature modNameStr name
    toGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
    signature = case extractUncurriedAbs value of
      Just { args, body } ->
        let
          annotation = extractFuncType value
          parameters = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } -> workerArguments toGoType args body
              (Array.take (Array.length args) fArgs)
              (if Array.length args < Array.length fArgs then Any else fRet)
              <> Array.replicate (Array.length args - Array.length fArgs) TypeValue
            Nothing -> Array.replicate (Array.length args) TypeValue
          result = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } | Array.length args >= Array.length fArgs ->
              workerResultType toGoType fRet
            _ -> TypeValue
        in
          fallback
            { fArgs = fromMaybe parameters (ListFilter.workerArguments metadata (Array.zip args parameters) result value)
            , fRet = result, arity = Array.length args }
      Nothing -> fallback
  in
    Tuple (sanitizeName name) signature

-- The ordinary native sum ABI intentionally boxes non-record payloads. For a
-- Tuple containing an array or an ADT pointer this would copy those payloads
-- merely to return them to a concrete caller, which immediately unboxes them.
-- The instantiated pointer layout is already established by the TAST and ADT
-- metadata. Publish that same layout to callers and retain the canonical box
-- only in the public getter. No body-specific or consumer-name rule is needed.
workerResultType :: (ExprType -> GoType) -> ExprType -> GoType
workerResultType toGoType result =
  let native = toGoType result
  in case native, getUnboxedADT result of
    TypeStructPointer pointer, Just (Tuple "Data.Tuple.Tuple" _)
      | Array.any erasedCompositeSlot pointer.typeArgs -> native
    _, Just (Tuple adtName adt) -> TypeStructValue adtName (adt.signature (adtPayloadTypes toGoType result))
    _, Nothing -> native
  where
  erasedCompositeSlot = case _ of
    TypeNativeArray _ -> true
    TypeStructPointer _ -> true
    _ -> false

-- Declarations and loop bodies share the same child translator as local
-- bindings. Each recursive group publishes its function declarations together.
declarations :: TranslateExpr -> CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> ModuleFunctions -> Array TcoBindingGroup -> Array GoDecl
declarations translate metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions groups =
  Array.concatMap
    ( \group ->
        let
          recVars = if group.recursive then map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> sanitizeName name) group.bindings else []

          context = { metadata, codegenStateRef, depth: 0, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions, bound: Map.empty, tcoIdent: Nothing, loopCtx: [], options: { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType: Nothing, mbExpectedGoType: Nothing }

          processBindingGroup :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> Array GoDecl
          processBindingGroup binds =
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val: val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) binds
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just fns ->
                  map (ModuleWorkers.declaration translate context (group.recursive && Array.length group.bindings == 1)) fns
                Nothing ->
                  Array.concatMap
                    ( \(Tuple (Ident name) expr) ->
                        let
                          res = translate (context { depth = 0, bound = Map.empty, tcoIdent = (Just (sanitizeName name)), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = (Just (annotationType expr)) }) 0 expr
                        in
                          [ GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name), expression: wrapInStmts [] res.stmts TypeValue (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res.expr res.exprType), goType: TypeValue } ]
                    )
                    binds
        in
          if group.recursive then
            processBindingGroup group.bindings
          else
            Array.concatMap (\b -> processBindingGroup [ b ]) group.bindings
    )
    groups

-- Cached values use only an outer annotation, not primitive-result inference.
annotationType :: TcoExpr -> ExprType
annotationType (TcoExpr _ (Typed ty _)) = ty
annotationType _ = Any

CHANGELOG.md.text:
# Changelog

All notable changes to gopurs are recorded here. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and the project uses
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

### Changed

- Expose native integer callbacks for cached, typed `Effect Int` actions.
  Preserve their ordinary entry point and deferred execution, and unwrap
  unary callbacks carrying function metadata without a recursive `Apply`.
- Cache immutable scalar literal conversions for polymorphic interface arguments
  of immediately executed foreign effects. Preserve the boxed FFI representation,
  deferred factory and effect calls, and ordinary conversion of dynamic inputs.
- Reduce affine countdowns containing unused global binding reads. Retain the
  first iteration's strict reads in order on the guarded positive path, and
  preserve the original loop for zero, negative or wide inputs.
- Emit native integer multiplication when operand bounds prove an exact
  product within the JavaScript Number integer range. Expose those bounds for
  counted translations while retaining ordinary IntMul semantics elsewhere.
- Reduce proven closed integer countdowns after thunk fusion, allowing existing
  affine loop optimization to eliminate repeated calls. Preserve strict reads,
  exact Int32 addition semantics and runtime input boundaries.
- Reduce fully consumed compositions of counted integer translations to guarded
  arithmetic. Preserve opaque runtime inputs, exact repeated-addition Int32
  semantics, and the original computation outside the proved input domain.
- Evaluate bounded closed recursive integer computations and record projections,
  retaining strict global reads and unknown computations. Bound interpreter
  work and stack depth separately, and allocate fresh residual bindings.
- Construct annotated Tuple results directly in the native representation
  required by their consumer, avoiding boxing and reconversion of composite
  fields while preserving the TAST and the existing public representation.
  Preserve constructor payloads and sum tags when converting native values
  to worker return values.
- Preserve boxed composite producers across annotations and local bindings
  until a consumer requires a native representation. Keep instantiated array
  and ADT-pointer payloads in native Tuple worker results; public wrappers
  retain the canonical boxed representation.
- Share literal record keys across allocations for records with one to five
  fields. Store two-Int records compactly while preserving immutable updates,
  field lookup and foreign conversion behavior.

## [0.1.1]

First final release, prepared from the RC20 compiler and pinned libraries.
Correct the recovery command's cyclic module import without rebuilding or
changing the qualified compiler.
Qualification and publication are recorded in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

- Compile the typed PureScript fork's TAST to Go with JavaScript or native
  compiler hosts, Release/Dev profiles and incremental compilation.
- Write ordinary Go FFI for values, records, callbacks, effects and cancellable
  asynchronous operations. The typed frontend is pinned to
  `ae6a6f644502bafcfa4fa94d8f81a1a1a1ca5080`; stock `purs` is not a substitute.
- Include RC20's callback, return-arity and ignored-Unit corrections, and the
  Foreign port's native readers preserving shared/cyclic child values.
- Refresh generated-code references against the preserved TAST types. Keep
  original compiler qualification and benchmark identities when reusing their
  exact bytes; record final packaging and fixture producers separately.

The supported reference is Node.js 24.8.0 and Go 1.27.0 on Linux amd64,
Linux arm64 and macOS arm64. This is a `0.x` release; the
[compatibility policy](docs/publication-scope.md) and
[limitations](docs/limitations.md) define its scope. The
[RC20 benchmark](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-benchmark.md#completed-rc20-campaign--13-november-2026-utc)
measures backend generation, not application runtime.

## [0.1.0] — not published

Signed tag `v0.1.0` remains available for traceability. Its CI stopped before
fixture execution or packaging because the artifact-acquisition command had
a cyclic module import. No npm package or GitHub release was published.
Version `0.1.1` resumes qualification with the corrected command and unchanged
RC20 compiler bytes.

## [0.1.0-rc.20]

Twentieth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared on 13 November 2026. It corrects
compiler bridge defects exposed during local qualification.
Qualification and publication remain pending in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Convert curried callback values through the native FFI bridge instead of
  assuming that a foreign function is already a boxed runtime value.
- Consume the TAST arguments actually accepted by the Go implementation,
  including arguments of a returned function; preserve a function result when
  Go returns it. Add focused regressions for both bridge cases.
- Preserve the original TAST annotation at zero-argument Go wrappers' ignored
  `Unit` boundary, so `Unit -> Int` with Go `func() any` produces an `Int`
  rather than an extra function. Keep `Fn0` scalar and function results intact.
- Pin the Foreign port's safe readers for native Go strings, booleans, numbers
  and slices. Indexed reads recognize native slices; reading an array or a
  property preserves shared and cyclic native child values.

The frontend and other library pins remain those of RC19. The compiler changes
require a new benchmark and complete validation; the historical RC18 campaign
and its local RC19 equality proof do not qualify this candidate.

## [0.1.0-rc.19]

Nineteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared on 13 November 2026, retaining
RC18's compiler, runtime and dependency pins. Qualification and publication
remain pending in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Include the Aff and Foreign native preflight paths in the isolated library
  cleanup fixture. Stub these preflights consistently with the other library
  runners, preserving the requirement to reach the mock Spago command and the
  neighbor-cache sentinels. Allow the isolated subprocess to start its own
  Node test runner by removing the inherited test-runner context from its
  environment. The real library scripts and native suites remain unchanged;
  this corrects the test setup that stopped RC18 qualification.

## [0.1.0-rc.18]

Eighteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC17's compiler and runtime.
Qualification and publication status remain in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Refresh the Release and Dev `FFIIntegerReturns` snapshots for the ordinary
  FFI array conversion introduced in RC15. The references now use the runtime
  array accessors, matching the generated code already exercised successfully
  by the JavaScript and native hosts. Compiler and runtime behavior are unchanged.
- Select the Go Buffer port in the `node-net` and `node-streams` test
  configurations and generated locks. Their Release and Dev suites pass with
  this dependency selection; the bootstrap manifest pins the reviewed commits.
- Supply Spec's two missing node-child-process value helpers: an undefined
  sentinel distinct from null, and kill-signal dispatch matching the stock
  JavaScript number/string conversion. This supports Spec's test dependency,
  not the complete node-child-process API. Contract checks and the complete
  Release/Dev Spec suites cover the new source pin.
- Record the incomplete historical HTTP benchmark input separately from
  compiler qualification. Its reachable `stdout` foreign binding lacked a Go
  implementation; the current library port already supplies it. Historical
  inputs and measurements remain unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.17]

Seventeenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC16's ordinary Go FFI contract,
dependency pins and frontend build fixes. Qualification and publication status
remain in the [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Emit missing-FFI annotations with identical JSON key order and string escaping
  on the JavaScript and native compiler hosts. The metadata keeps the same
  schema and decoded values; generated executable code is unchanged. A real
  batch-compilation regression checks byte identity and JSON round-tripping
  across hosts, including Unicode, quotes, backslashes and literal escapes.

## [0.1.0-rc.16]

Sixteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC15's ordinary Go FFI, dependency
pins and compatibility scope. The [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
tracks qualification and publication.

### Fixed

- Keep the selected typed and stock frontends rooted in Nix throughout CI and
  publication smoke tests, so garbage collection cannot remove them between
  build and execution.
- Correct the test domain in the Nix frontend dependency Foundation 0.0.30:
  integer division properties now exclude quotients that cannot be represented
  by their tested type, as well as division by zero. This prevents the
  reproducible `Int8 (-128) / (-1)` test overflow found during RC15 qualification.
  Foundation implementation code and test configuration are unchanged: Linux
  CI keeps the complete suite enabled; Darwin retains the pinned nixpkgs
  policy and was checked explicitly with the failing seed (6,121 tests).

## [0.1.0-rc.15]

Fifteenth experimental candidate for `0.1.0`. Its qualification and publication
status are recorded in the live [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
and [release checklist](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-checklist.md).
At preparation on 12 November 2026, RC14 was the published candidate on `next`
and `latest` selected RC7. Local FFI results do not qualify RC15's final artifacts.

### Added

- [Ordinary Go FFI](docs/ffi-idiomatic.md): native `Effect` and `EffectFnAff`
  results, Go errors, optional `context.Context`, typed callbacks, opaque
  handles and closed-record conversion to local Go structs. Generated adapters
  own the runtime integration; handwritten implementations can use Go tooling
  directly. Direct ordinary `Aff`, open-record layout inference and a general
  multi-constructor ADT mapping remain outside this contract.
- Focused parser, runtime race, documented-example, end-to-end and installed
  package regressions, including both compiler hosts, cold/warm caches,
  signature changes, rejection and recovery.

### Fixed

- Keep asynchronous operations lazy and repeatable, arbitrate completion and
  cancellation, and release failed or late acquisitions exactly once before
  ownership transfers. Callbacks retained by a Go service follow that service's
  explicit unsubscribe/close lifetime.
- Convert dynamic `Foreign` data without JSON round-trips; preserve native
  handles, nested containers, null and a distinct undefined marker. Functions
  and algebraic constructors still require an explicit PureScript conversion.
- Diagnose missing TAST metadata before optimization and incompatible expanded
  `EffectFn2`/`EffectFn3` results with frontend, `PATH` and clean-output guidance.
  Require nominal `EffectFnAff` metadata for its ordinary Go ABI; retain valid
  explicit callback implementations. Preserve valid cache state after an FFI
  signature error.
- Validate missing FFI in explicitly selected entry-point scopes, and retain
  the cleanup of build/test tooling and the separately pinned Argonaut codecs
  support checkout already integrated since RC14.

### Changed

- Pin the typed frontend to `ae6a6f644502bafcfa4fa94d8f81a1a1a1ca5080`,
  `gopurs-aff` to `dbe9ff1c574a18352cf9ec861090083b14ca0246`, and
  `gopurs-foreign` to `c79499d6c22fd0637104bec5449434cfb6e31fe4`.
  Rebuild frontend output after switching revisions, preserving application
  `go.mod` and `go.sum`; the `purs` version number alone does not identify the
  required TAST contract. Existing explicit runtime FFI remains supported.

## [0.1.0-rc.14]

Fourteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, with a deterministic spec timeout fixture
following RC13's macOS Dev failure. The exact signed tag passed qualification
on all three supported platforms and its artifacts were reviewed. Published on
npm `next` and as a GitHub prerelease; public Hello, b8x compilation/linking and
the real `next` rollback to RC7 followed by restoration to RC14 passed. `latest`
remains RC7. The embedded documentation deviation and rollback scope are recorded in [the quality report](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md#rc14-qualification-and-artifact-review--5-november-2026).

### Fixed

- Pin `gopurs-spec` at `7bbb30f00bfde95cdb39286662bb5a0f71e3f368`
  ([spec PR #2](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs-spec/pull/2),
  reviewed and merged): replace the 15 ms body delay in the fail-fast timeout
  fixture with cancellable `never`, retaining the 10 ms timeout and golden
  output. Targeted local Dev and Release checks pass under CPU contention;
  they use a development toolchain and do not qualify this candidate.

Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer, all other source pins and CI workflows
are unchanged. RC13's tag and results remain unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.13]

Thirteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, correcting the CI input selector after RC12.
Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer, library pins and test corpus remain
unchanged. Qualification failed in macOS spec Dev: 73 passing, 3 pending and
one failing timeout fixture. Both Linux core jobs and macOS spec Release passed;
fixtures and finalization were skipped. RC13 remains unqualified and unpublished,
and its tag is immutable.

### Fixed

- Accept an aggregate GitHub run status of `queued` when selecting fixture,
  qualification or finalized inputs. Keep requiring the exact successful
  producer jobs, source and artifact identities, and signature checks.
  Pending or failed producers continue to block selection.

## [0.1.0-rc.12]

Twelfth candidate for `0.1.0`, correcting the Nix cache inventory check that
blocked RC11 before Linux quality tests. Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer,
library pins and test corpus remain unchanged. Three build/core jobs passed,
but nine fixture shards failed before import because the input selector
rejected the aggregate run status `queued`. The run subsequently completed
with failure. RC12 remains unqualified and unpublished; its signed tag is
immutable.

### Fixed

- Accept the empty `realisations` directory created by Nix 2.28.3 during a
  runtime-path cache export. Continue rejecting nonempty auxiliary directories,
  symlinks and unknown cache entries; no metadata is silently discarded.

## [0.1.0-rc.11]

Eleventh candidate for `0.1.0`, grouping CI recovery and documentation after
RC10's infrastructure failures. Compiler, runtime, TAST/frontend, optimizer
and library pins are unchanged. Both Linux jobs failed at the runtime-cache
export inventory check; RC11 remains unqualified and unpublished.

### Changed

- Reuse the build's exact locked Nix runtime environment in fixture shards,
  with bounded preparation and diagnostics, instead of rebuilding that
  environment in every shard.
- Retain the actual producer attempt for each qualification artifact so a
  targeted retry can reuse successful work from the same run and source.
  Exact compiler and toolchain identities remain required; historical tags
  and their qualification results are unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.10]

Tenth candidate for `0.1.0`, carrying the compiler/runtime and platform choices
of RC9 with the corrected spec source pin. Both qualification attempts failed
in environment/bootstrap preparation; the complete retry passed all three
builds and eleven fixture shards but timed out before the remaining shard's
tests. RC10 is unqualified and unpublished; RC7 remains public.

### Fixed

- Pin `gopurs-spec` at `c88da162df5d9ef85d672f5f2e819bb287e9647b`:
  await cancellation of compiler subprocesses and their process groups before
  reusing an integration directory; emit native child `close` only after
  stdout/stderr delivery and `exit`. Include native lifecycle and Aff
  cancellation regressions. Keep fixture source and golden output unchanged.
- Give a whole integration case, including cold compilation, a finite default
  budget of 300 seconds before parsing explicit timeout options. Log each
  preparation/runtime phase so future failures identify the expensive command.

Local corrected-source spec tests pass in Release and Dev (74 passing,
3 pending, all nine integration cases per profile). They use a development
frontend on macOS arm64 and do not replace this candidate's full qualification.

## [0.1.0-rc.9]

Ninth candidate for `0.1.0`, carrying the same compiler, runtime and dependency
pins as RC8. Qualification failed in the macOS spec integration tests; RC9
is unpublished and its tag remains immutable. RC7 remains public.

### Fixed

- Move both the macOS build and fixture jobs to the ARM64 `macos-15` runner.
  GitHub cancelled RC8's macOS job before any steps ran during the macOS 14
  retirement schedule. The new qualification does not establish compatibility
  with macOS 14. Keep the build and fixture runner matrices consistent through
  the CI policy regression test.

## [0.1.0-rc.8]

Eighth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared from the post-RC7 fixes and reviewed
cleanup. Its macOS job was cancelled before any steps ran because GitHub
retired that runner image; the remaining campaign was cancelled. RC8 is
unqualified and unpublished. Its signed tag remains immutable, and RC7 remains
the published candidate.

The TAST frontend remains pinned to
`105f5752b39cc0f6c99a40064295338bf57ad223`, and the backend optimizer to
`4e7de48ffd6e19480ed3de6bfe8ca8227133be13`. The supported targets remain Linux
amd64/arm64 and macOS arm64. Rust stays experimental, and the documented
compatibility limits still apply. The existing benchmark record predates this
candidate; it does not establish RC8 performance results.

### Fixed

- Keep the original producer job and artifact attempt when GitHub copies a
  completed execution into retry metadata. Require matching execution evidence
  and keep newer failed or pending executions blocking recovery.
- Accept npm's absent-to-empty DSSE `keyid` serialization without changing
  signed payloads, signature bytes or cryptographic verification requirements.
- Pin the node-fs synchronous/asynchronous `chmod` and file stream fixes, the
  native node-streams pipe implementation, and the node-http/event-emitter
  response-body fixes. Preserve the targeted regressions and add the missing
  Go `stdout` adaptation used by the HTTP tests.
- Complete the identified uuid and js-bigints source metadata and attribution
  corrections without changing their library code or existing licenses.

### Changed

- Include all 51 pinned library suites through `bin/modtest` in future full
  release qualification, in Release and Dev profiles. Reuse the native compiler,
  trim the private Go cache between libraries, retain campaign reports and logs,
  and require exact library revisions and complete coverage before finalization.
  Ordinary quick CI and existing release tags keep their current scope.
- Replace external HTTP test endpoints with a local HTTPS fixture, retaining
  certificate verification and refusal tests. Remove the unused `go get`
  resolution of `strcase` from strings-extra.
- Derive the optional quick-CI frontend cache key from its Nix derivation and
  platform. Full candidate qualification continues to bypass this cache.
- Group compiler host services under `Gopurs.Host`, move the embedded runtime
  source under `Gopurs.Runtime.Source`, and document the module map and naming.
  Add output-identity and documentation checks; quick receipts now require all
  24 gates under `linux-quick-v2`. Check test inventories before CI builds.

The next candidate must validate its own exact artifacts, 371 gates per
platform (including 51 libraries and 401 fixtures in each profile), signatures
and installation. Historical RC7 and local post-RC7 results remain supporting
evidence only; they do not close those candidate gates. RC7 reinstallation has
been checked locally, but application suitability and public rollback remain
open in the release checklist.

## [0.1.0-rc.7]

Seventh candidate for `0.1.0`. RC6 was not published: its Linux amd64 core
campaign exposed an intermittent asynchronous emission failure. The macOS and
Linux arm64 core jobs passed; fixture shards did not run. Earlier tags remain
immutable.

### Fixed

- Return pipelined worker failures as explicit results and propagate them at
  dependency joins and producer boundaries. A worker error no longer escapes
  globally while its producer is suspended, including under supervision.
  Failures remain sticky and prevent queued dependent batches from starting.
- Include emission lifecycle regression tests in quick PR qualification.
- Retry signing and draft upload using the exact successful qualification of
  the same immutable tag, preserving the original test and compiler identities.
- Use pinned Node directly for finalization, avoiding a redundant Nix setup,
  and balance Release/Dev batches across the four existing fixture shards.

## [0.1.0-rc.6]

Sixth candidate for `0.1.0`, with the compiler and dependency pins of RC5.
RC5 passed all three core jobs and all twelve fixture shards, but final
attestation failed. It was not published; its signed tag remains immutable.

### Fixed

- Add a reproducible UUID serial number to the CycloneDX dependency inventory,
  required by the GitHub attestation action.
- Recover an existing Rekor entry when the signing service accepted a request
  but its retry returned HTTP 409. Continue to verify the complete signature,
  transparency-log proof, artifact digest and GitHub workflow identity before
  accepting the recovered entry.
- Publish using the CI provenance bundle already verified for the candidate,
  preserving the same attestation for publication recovery.

## [0.1.0-rc.5]

Fifth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, dependencies and feature
scope of RC4. RC4 was not published: all three core jobs and ten fixture shards
passed, but a Linux runner lost communication and two macOS fixtures could not
start Spago (`ENOENT`). The signed RC4 tag remains immutable.

### Changed

- Keep CI development tools reachable through a persistent Nix profile for the
  lifetime of each job. This adds an explicit garbage-collection root instead
  of relying on platform-dependent process inspection. Garbage collection has
  not been established as the cause of the RC4 macOS failure.
- Include the working directory and searched executable paths, with existence
  checks, when a fixture command cannot start. Preserve the original failure;
  do not silently retry or skip it.

## [0.1.0-rc.4]

Fourth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, pinned dependencies,
features and limitations below. RC3 was not published: all three build/core
jobs passed, but fixture qualification failed. A local reproduction exposed a
race while initializing Spago's shared registry cache. The previous signed
candidate tags remain immutable.

### Fixed

- Initialize fixture dependencies once with `spago fetch` before starting
  parallel batches on a fresh runner. Keep fresh fixture workspaces, both build
  profiles, the existing resource limits and all 401 fixtures per profile.
- Preserve Spago diagnostics on a failed fixture by removing its quiet flag.
- Reuse qualified PR results after merge even when GitHub clears the run's PR
  association list, while checking the actual tested tree, parents, receipt,
  repository, run and artifact identity.
- Import cached frontend tools using their complete Nix store paths and verify
  the imported paths before recording success.

### Changed

- Run ordinary PR checks on Linux amd64 and skip heavy builds for documentation
  changes. Tags and explicit full campaigns retain all three supported targets.
- Cache the pinned frontend runtime closure for quick runs; missing or unusable
  cache entries fall back to a fresh build. Full release runs remain independent
  of this cache.
- Align active public installation examples and candidate tables with this
  version, and check tag/package/lockfile/changelog agreement before heavy builds.

## [0.1.0-rc.3]

Third candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, pinned dependencies,
features and limitations of the candidates below. RC2 was not published:
its Linux core gates passed, but the checkout action replaced the local
annotated tag with its peeled commit and artifact preparation rejected it.
The signed RC1 and RC2 tags are retained.

### Fixed

- Select release tags explicitly in every CI checkout, preserving their
  annotated objects while retaining the default commit selection for PRs.
- Check source commit and annotated tag identity immediately after checkout.
  Verify that the local tag object matches GitHub's verified signature before
  starting the release build.

## [0.1.0-rc.2]

Second candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the frontend, bootstrap dependencies,
features and known limitations listed for `0.1.0-rc.1` below. The first candidate
was not published to npm or GitHub Releases: its full macOS gate timed out while
compiling the native scanner test, and both Linux jobs reached their six-hour
limit during the fixture campaign. The signed first-candidate tag is retained.

### Fixed

- Compile the native scanner, preparation and emission functional probes without
  Go optimizations for their large compiler package, keeping the existing memory
  budget, assertions, execution deadlines, scanner stack limit and race checks.
  Release compiler binaries retain their optimized bootstrap profile.
- Include the scanner and preparation probes in the quick CI campaign so their
  compilation and execution are checked before creating another release tag.
- Publish build manifests, FFI digests and global-function sidecars from each
  cache session's private stage. Concurrent builds no longer share a temporary
  sidecar path that another writer can rename, causing an `ENOENT` failure.
- Separate full CI into core checks and four fixture shards per platform,
  reusing the exact candidate compiler. Require complete Release/Dev coverage
  and matching source, compiler and run identities before signing artifacts.
- Upload stable quality logs and reports instead of live generated workspaces,
  avoiding missing-file errors while interrupted processes clean up temporary
  compiler snapshots.

## [0.1.0-rc.1]

First release candidate for `0.1.0`, using the typed PureScript compiler at
`105f5752b39cc0f6c99a40064295338bf57ad223` and the bootstrap libraries pinned in
`bootstrap-sources.json`. The [qualification record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
distinguishes completed local checks from the remaining tag and public-install
gates. The [benchmark protocol](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-benchmark.md) defines the cold and
warm measurements; the historical reference is the official altbak.pub table.

### Added

- First public release candidate preparation for `0.1.0`.
- PureScript-to-Go backend driven by typed TAST.
- JavaScript, native Go and experimental Rust compiler hosts.
- Content-verified incremental cache and optional Go package layout.
- Go runtime, FFI bridge and event loop.
- Compiler bootstrap documentation, checksums and clean-install checks.
- Publication scope, limitations, migration, CLI, quickstart and troubleshooting
  documentation.
- npm package allowlist and package-surface check.
- CI for Linux arm64/amd64 and macOS arm64.
- Nix packages, apps, development shell and application checks with pinned
  frontend, Node.js and Go toolchains.
- Public, commit-pinned bootstrap library inventory and `bin/setup --locked`.
- Versioned Argonaut codec adaptation for the native bootstrap.

### Fixed

- Go `int32` FFI arguments and results preserve signed integer values through
  scalar, array and callback bridges instead of falling through to pointer
  unboxing.

- The private output-barrier cache test now copies the `c1c` module resolved by
  `build-cache/go.mod`.
- Cache transition tests pin the monolithic layout and disable pack publication
  when they inspect individual cache objects.
- The context-transition check accounts for prepared fingerprints that are
  legitimately reused within a run.

### Known limitations

- The backend remains experimental and is not a drop-in replacement for the
  upstream PureScript compiler.
- The typed compiler fork and Go library ports are separate prerequisites.
- Stock PureScript libraries expose JavaScript FFI and may fail at runtime when
  a foreign declaration is reached.
- Windows, 32-bit targets, daemon/resident modes and the Rust host are outside
  the `0.1.x` production contract.
- Performance figures are measurements, not guarantees.

### Security

- No public security release has been made yet. See `SECURITY.md`.

module Gopurs.EffectExprs
  ( bindEffect
  , pureValue
  , defer
  , primitive
  , wrap
  , wrapCachedInt
  ) where

import Prelude
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (executeIfOpaque, getExprType, isEffectNode, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendEffect(..), BackendSyntax(Abs, EffectDefer, Let, LetRec), Level)

bindEffect :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
bindEffect translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, bound, options: { isTail } } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    stripEffectDefer (TcoExpr a syn) = case unwrapTcoExpr (TcoExpr a syn) of
      EffectDefer inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Abs _ inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Let ident lvl_ val body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (Let ident lvl_ val i))
      LetRec lvl_ bindings_ body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (LetRec lvl_ bindings_ i))
      _ -> Tuple false (TcoExpr a syn)
    Tuple wasStripped realBinding = stripEffectDefer binding
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) realBinding
    resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: true } }) resBinding.nextId body
    bindingExpr = if wasStripped then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType else executeIfOpaque realBinding (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType)
    bodyExpr = executeIfOpaque body resBody.expr
  in
    { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (GoAssign name bindingExpr) <> resBody.stmts, expr: bodyExpr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

pureValue :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
pureValue translate context@{ depth } nextId binding =
  translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding

defer :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
defer translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId binding =
  let
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding
    funcExpr = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
      [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
          (flattenStmts resBinding.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType) ])
          TypeValue
      ]
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: funcExpr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resBinding.nextId }

primitive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> BackendEffect TcoExpr -> ExprResult
primitive translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId eff =
  case eff of
  EffectRefNew a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "NewSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId + 1
      }
  EffectRefRead a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ReadSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId
      }
  EffectRefWrite ref val ->
    let
      resRef = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId ref
      resVal = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) resRef.nextId val
    in
      { stmts: resRef.stmts <> resVal.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WriteSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resRef.expr resRef.exprType
          , boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resVal.expr resVal.exprType
          ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resVal.nextId
      }

wrap :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
wrap translate context nextId tcoExpr =
  let
    res = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId tcoExpr
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: boxedAction context res, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: res.nextId }

-- ModuleBindings calls this only for values initialized by a cached getter.
-- Match exactly the effect syntax wrap already defers: aliases, factories and
-- EffectDefer retain their existing construction/evaluation boundaries.
wrapCachedInt :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
wrapCachedInt translate context nextId expression = do
  case getExprType expression of
    ADT "Effect.Effect" _ [ Int ] -> pure unit
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (isEffectNode expression)
  let
    result = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId expression
    -- Translate once, retaining the original boxed body as an independent
    -- entry point. Each invocation executes exactly one of these bodies.
    nativeResult = case result.exprType, result.expr of
      TypeInt64, value -> Just value
      TypeValue, GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ value ] -> Just value
      _, _ -> Nothing
    action = case nativeResult of
      Just value ->
        let native = GoFuncBlock [] (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn value ]) TypeInt64
        in GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WithFunctionData") [ boxedAction context result, native ]
      -- Boxed dynamic results retain the FFI's complete Unbox semantics.
      -- Reuse this translation even when it cannot provide a native entry.
      Nothing -> boxedAction context result
  pure { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: action, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: result.nextId }

boxedAction :: ExprContext -> ExprResult -> GoExpr
boxedAction { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } result =
  GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
    [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
        (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) ])
        TypeValue
    ]

src/Gopurs/FfiBridge/Values.purs.text:
module Gopurs.FfiBridge.Values
  ( boxedArgument
  , nativeArgument
  , toValue
  , workerReturn
  ) where

import Prelude

import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.Structured as Structured
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.TypeSupport (flattenFuncArgs, getTastArgType, getTastReturnType, isPointerNode, isRuntimeValueNode, isStandardPursFunc, isUncurriedFunction, printTypeNode, resolveNewtype)
import Gopurs.FfiTypes (TypeNode(..))
import Gopurs.GoTypes (isClosedRowTail)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (DataDecl, ExprType(..))

boxedArgument :: Array DataDecl -> Maybe ExprType -> Int -> TypeNode -> Array String
boxedArgument dataDecls mbTast i t
  | Just tast <- mbTast >>= \ft -> getTastArgType ft i
  , Structured.needsConversion t tast =
      [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := " <> Structured.fromValue (\go ps value -> fromValue dataDecls go (Just ps) value 0) t tast ("arg" <> show i) ]
boxedArgument dataDecls mbTast i t =
  let
    typStr = printTypeNode t
    tastArg = mbTast >>= \tast -> getTastArgType tast i
  in
    case t of
      TNamed "any" | isForeign tastArg -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.ForeignValue(arg" <> show i <> ")" ]
      TNamed "interface{}" | isForeign tastArg -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.ForeignValue(arg" <> show i <> ")" ]
      TArray (TNamed "any") | isForeignArray tastArg -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.ForeignValue(arg" <> show i <> ").([]any)" ]
      TArray (TNamed "interface{}") | isForeignArray tastArg -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.ForeignValue(arg" <> show i <> ").([]any)" ]
      TArray _ | isOpaqueType tastArg -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.Unbox[" <> typStr <> "](arg" <> show i <> ")" ]
      TFunc _ _ -> callbackArgument dataDecls tastArg i t
      _ | isPointerNode t ->
        -- Match Unbox's pointer cases without passing Value through any. That
        -- conversion otherwise allocates even when the native handle is reused.
        [ "\tvar go_arg" <> show i <> " " <> typStr
        , "\tif arg" <> show i <> ".Type == gopurs_runtime.TypeAny {"
        , "\t\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " = arg" <> show i <> ".AnyVal().(" <> typStr <> ")"
        , "\t} else {"
        , "\t\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " = *(*" <> typStr <> ")(arg" <> show i <> ".UnsafePtr)"
        , "\t}"
        ]
      TArray _ | typStr /= "[]gopurs_runtime.Value" ->
        [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := " <> fromValue dataDecls t tastArg ("arg" <> show i) 0 ]
      TNamed "any" -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i ]
      TNamed "interface{}" -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i ]
      TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value" -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i ]
      TMap _ _ ->
        let
          et = String.drop (String.indexOf (Pattern "]") typStr # fromMaybe 0 # add 1) typStr
          resolvedTast = map (resolveNewtype dataDecls) tastArg
          isOpaque = case resolvedTast of
            Just (Record _) -> false
            _ -> true
        in
          if isOpaque then
            [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.UnboxObject(arg" <> show i <> ")" ]
          else if et == "any" || et == "interface{}" then
            [ "\targ" <> show i <> "_map := gopurs_runtime.RecordToMap(arg" <> show i <> ")"
            , "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := make(" <> typStr <> ")"
            , "\tfor k, v := range arg" <> show i <> "_map { go_arg" <> show i <> "[k] = v }"
            ]
          else
            [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i <> ".PtrVal().(" <> typStr <> ")" ]
      _ -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := gopurs_runtime.Unbox[" <> typStr <> "](arg" <> show i <> ")" ]

-- Worker scalar/container arguments already have their native representation.
-- Callback parameters still arrive as Value and use the wrapper's adapter.
nativeArgument :: Array DataDecl -> ExprType -> Int -> TypeNode -> Array String
nativeArgument dataDecls tast i t = case t of
  TFunc _ _ -> callbackArgument dataDecls (getTastArgType tast i) i t
  _ | isPointerNode t -> boxedArgument dataDecls (Just tast) i t
  _ -> [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i ]

callbackArgument :: Array DataDecl -> Maybe ExprType -> Int -> TypeNode -> Array String
callbackArgument dataDecls tastArg i t =
  let
    -- Opaque newtypes can carry native functions rather than boxed PS callbacks.
    isOpaque = case tastArg of
      Just (ADT name _ _) -> not (isUncurriedFunction name || name == "Effect.Effect")
      Just Any -> true
      Just (TypeVar _) -> true
      _ -> false
  in
    if isOpaque && not (isStandardPursFunc t) then
      [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := (*(*any)(arg" <> show i <> ".UnsafePtr)).(" <> printTypeNode t <> ")" ]
    else
      let
        adapter = fromValue dataDecls t tastArg ("arg" <> show i) 0
        indented = String.replaceAll (Pattern "\n") (Replacement "\n\t") adapter
      in
        [ "\tgo_arg" <> show i <> " := " <> indented ]

-- Adapt values flowing from boxed PureScript callbacks into native Go types.
fromValue :: Array DataDecl -> TypeNode -> Maybe ExprType -> String -> Int -> String
fromValue dataDecls t (Just tast) valName depth
  | Structured.needsConversion t tast = Structured.fromValue (\go ps value -> fromValue dataDecls go (Just ps) value depth) t tast valName
-- Nested native arrays require element conversion at every level. A slice of
-- boxed Values cannot be reinterpreted as a slice of scalar Go elements.
fromValue dataDecls array@(TArray item) mbTast valName depth
  | not (isOpaqueType mbTast) && not (isRuntimeValueNode item) =
      let
        itemTast = case mbTast of
          Just (Array tast) -> Just tast
          _ -> Nothing
        element = "gopurs_runtime.ArrayAccess(_source, _i)"
        converted = case item of
          TNamed name | (name == "any" || name == "interface{}") && not (isForeign itemTast) -> element
          _ -> fromValue dataDecls item itemTast element (depth + 1)
      in
        "func() " <> printTypeNode array <> " { _source := " <> valName
          <> "; _out := make(" <> printTypeNode array <> ", gopurs_runtime.ArrayLength(_source)); for _i := range _out { _out[_i] = "
          <> converted <> " }; return _out }()"
-- Resolve this exact optional entry once when adapting an Effect Int callback.
-- Actions without matching metadata keep the ordinary Apply/Unbox entry.
fromValue _ (TFunc [] (Just (TNamed native))) (Just (ADT "Effect.Effect" _ [ Int ])) valName _
  | native == "int" || native == "int64" =
      let
        fast = if native == "int64" then "__gopurs_native_action"
          else "func() int { return int(__gopurs_native_action()) }"
      in
        "func(__gopurs_action gopurs_runtime.Value) func() " <> native <> " {\n"
          <> "\t\tif __gopurs_native_action, ok := gopurs_runtime.FunctionData[func() int64](__gopurs_action); ok { return " <> fast <> " }\n"
          <> "\t\treturn func() " <> native <> " { return gopurs_runtime.Unbox[" <> native <> "](gopurs_runtime.Apply(__gopurs_action, gopurs_runtime.Value{})) }\n"
          <> "\t}(" <> valName <> ")"
fromValue dataDecls (TFunc args ret) mbTast valName depth =
  let
    paramsArr = Array.mapWithIndex (\cidx atype -> "p" <> show depth <> "_" <> show cidx <> " " <> printTypeNode atype) args
    applyArgsArr = Array.mapWithIndex
      ( \cidx atype ->
          case atype of
            TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value" -> "p" <> show depth <> "_" <> show cidx
            TFunc _ _ ->
              let
                wrapped = toValue dataDecls atype (mbTast >>= \tast -> getTastArgType tast cidx) ("p" <> show depth <> "_" <> show cidx)
              in
                String.replaceAll (Pattern "\n") (Replacement "\n\t\t") wrapped
            _ -> toValue dataDecls atype (mbTast >>= \tast -> getTastArgType tast cidx) ("p" <> show depth <> "_" <> show cidx)
      )
      args
    params = String.joinWith ", " paramsArr
    applyArgs = String.joinWith ", " applyArgsArr
    rawApplyCall =
      if Array.length args == 1 then
        "gopurs_runtime.Apply(" <> valName <> ", " <> applyArgs <> ")"
      else if Array.length args > 1 then
        "gopurs_runtime.Apply" <> show (Array.length args) <> "(" <> valName <> ", " <> applyArgs <> ")"
      else
        "gopurs_runtime.Apply(" <> valName <> ", gopurs_runtime.Value{})"
    applyCall = case mbTast >>= getTastReturnType of
      Just (ADT "Effect.Effect" _ _) | nativeCallbackResult ret -> "gopurs_runtime.Apply(" <> rawApplyCall <> ", gopurs_runtime.Value{})"
      _ -> rawApplyCall
    resultTast = case mbTast >>= getTastReturnType of
      Just (ADT "Effect.Effect" _ [result]) | nativeCallbackResult ret -> Just result
      other -> other
    nativeReturn result =
      "func(" <> params <> ") " <> printTypeNode result <> " {\n\t\tinner_res" <> show depth <> " := " <> applyCall
        <> "\n\t\treturn " <> fromValue dataDecls result resultTast ("inner_res" <> show depth) (depth + 1) <> "\n\t}"

  in
    case ret of
      Nothing ->
        "func(" <> params <> ") {\n\t\t" <> applyCall <> "\n\t}"
      Just array@(TArray _) -> nativeReturn array
      Just dynamic@(TNamed "any") | isForeign resultTast -> nativeReturn dynamic
      Just dynamic@(TNamed "interface{}") | isForeign resultTast -> nativeReturn dynamic
      Just (TNamed "any") -> "func(" <> params <> ") any {\n\t\treturn " <> applyCall <> "\n\t}"
      Just (TNamed "interface{}") -> "func(" <> params <> ") interface{} {\n\t\treturn " <> applyCall <> "\n\t}"
      Just (TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value") -> "func(" <> params <> ") gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\treturn " <> applyCall <> "\n\t}"
      Just f@(TFunc _ _) ->
        let
          innerUnwrap = fromValue dataDecls f (mbTast >>= getTastReturnType) ("inner_res" <> show depth) (depth + 1)
        in
          "func(" <> params <> ") " <> printTypeNode f <> " {\n\t\tinner_res" <> show depth <> " := " <> applyCall <> "\n\t\treturn " <> innerUnwrap <> "\n\t}"
      Just r -> nativeReturn r
fromValue _ (TNamed anyT) mbTast valName _ | (anyT == "any" || anyT == "interface{}") && isForeign mbTast = "gopurs_runtime.ForeignValue(" <> valName <> ")"
fromValue dataDecls (TNamed anyT) mbTast valName depth | anyT == "any" || anyT == "interface{}" || anyT == "gopurs_runtime.Value" =
  let
    resolvedTast = map (resolveNewtype dataDecls) mbTast
  in
    case resolvedTast of
      Just (Record (Row fields tail)) | isClosedRowTail tail ->
        let
          fieldStr = map
            ( \(Tuple fK fT) ->
                "\t\t\t\tres_map[\"" <> fK <> "\"] = " <> fromValue dataDecls (TNamed "any") (Just fT) ("_raw[\"" <> fK <> "\"]") (depth + 1)
            )
            fields
        in
          "func() map[string]any {\n\t\t\t_raw := gopurs_runtime.RecordToMap(" <> valName <> ")\n\t\t\tres_map := make(map[string]any)\n" <> String.joinWith "\n" fieldStr <> "\n\t\t\treturn res_map\n\t\t}()"
      Just f@(Func _ _) ->
        fromValue dataDecls (exprTypeToDummyTypeNode f) resolvedTast valName depth
      _ -> "gopurs_runtime.Unbox[" <> anyT <> "](" <> valName <> ")"
fromValue _ t _ valName _ = "gopurs_runtime.Unbox[" <> printTypeNode t <> "](" <> valName <> ")"

exprTypeToDummyTypeNode :: ExprType -> TypeNode
exprTypeToDummyTypeNode (Func args ret) = TFunc (map exprTypeToDummyTypeNode args) (Just (exprTypeToDummyTypeNode ret))
exprTypeToDummyTypeNode (Array elem) = TArray (exprTypeToDummyTypeNode elem)
exprTypeToDummyTypeNode (Record _) = TMap (TNamed "string") (TNamed "any")
exprTypeToDummyTypeNode _ = TNamed "any"

boxScalar :: TypeNode -> String -> String
boxScalar (TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value") valName = valName
boxScalar (TNamed "int64") valName = "gopurs_runtime.Int(" <> valName <> ")"
boxScalar (TNamed "int") valName = "gopurs_runtime.Int(int64(" <> valName <> "))"
boxScalar _ valName = "gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> valName <> ")"

-- A Value already has the required representation, even for PS records and
-- functions. Exact Value -> Value callbacks need no forwarding closure.
toValue :: Array DataDecl -> TypeNode -> Maybe ExprType -> String -> String
toValue dataDecls t (Just tast) valName
  | Structured.needsConversion t tast = Structured.toValue (\go ps value -> toValue dataDecls go (Just ps) value) t tast valName
toValue _ (TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value") _ valName = valName
toValue _ (TFunc [ TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value" ] (Just (TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value"))) _ valName =
  "gopurs_runtime.Func(" <> valName <> ")"
toValue dataDecls (TFunc args ret) mbTast valName =
  let
    genInner val innerWrap =
      "gopurs_runtime.Func(func(_ gopurs_runtime.Value) gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t" <> val <> "\n\t\t\treturn " <> innerWrap <> "\n\t\t})"
    genInnerArg val innerWrap argUnwrap =
      "gopurs_runtime.Func(func(arg gopurs_runtime.Value) gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t" <> val <> "(" <> argUnwrap <> ")\n\t\t\treturn " <> innerWrap <> "\n\t\t})"
  in
    case Array.head args of
      Nothing ->
        case ret of
          Nothing -> genInner (valName <> "()") "gopurs_runtime.Value{}"
          Just r -> genInner ("inner_res := " <> valName <> "()") (toValue dataDecls r (mbTast >>= getTastReturnType) "inner_res")
      Just a ->
        let
          argUnwrap = case a of
            TNamed "any" -> "arg"
            TNamed "interface{}" -> "arg"
            TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value" -> "arg"
            f@(TFunc _ _) -> String.replaceAll (Pattern "\n") (Replacement "\n\t\t\t") (fromValue dataDecls f (mbTast >>= \tast -> getTastArgType tast 0) "arg" 99)
            -- Native callbacks can receive structural records and nested
            -- containers too. Their PS arguments need the same field/element
            -- conversion as ordinary FFI parameters, not a raw reinterpretation.
            _ -> fromValue dataDecls a (mbTast >>= \tast -> getTastArgType tast 0) "arg" 99
        in
          case ret of
            Nothing -> genInnerArg valName "gopurs_runtime.Value{}" argUnwrap
            Just r -> genInnerArg ("inner_res := " <> valName) (toValue dataDecls r (mbTast >>= getTastReturnType) "inner_res") argUnwrap
toValue _ (TArray _) mbTast valName | isOpaqueType mbTast = "gopurs_runtime.Any(" <> valName <> ")"
toValue dataDecls (TArray elem) mbTast valName | printTypeNode elem /= "gopurs_runtime.Value" =
  let
    itemTast = case mbTast of
      Just (Array t) -> Just t
      _ -> Nothing
  in
  "func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\tres_arr := make([]gopurs_runtime.Value, len(" <> valName <> "))\n\t\t\tfor i, v := range " <> valName <> " { res_arr[i] = " <> toValue dataDecls elem itemTast "v" <> " }\n\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Array(res_arr)\n\t\t}()"
toValue dataDecls (TMap _ _) (Just (Record (Row fields tail))) valName | isClosedRowTail tail =
  let
    fieldStr = map
      ( \(Tuple fK fT) ->
          "\t\t\t\tres_map[\"" <> fK <> "\"] = " <> toValue dataDecls (TNamed "any") (Just fT) ("_raw[\"" <> fK <> "\"]")
      )
      fields
  in
    "func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t_raw := " <> valName <> "\n\t\t\tres_map := make(map[string]gopurs_runtime.Value)\n" <> String.joinWith "\n" fieldStr <> "\n\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Record(res_map)\n\t\t}()"
toValue dataDecls (TMap _ _) mbTast valName =
  let
    resolvedTast = map (resolveNewtype dataDecls) mbTast
    isOpaque = case resolvedTast of
      Just (Record _) -> false
      _ -> true
  in
    if isOpaque then
      "gopurs_runtime.Any(" <> valName <> ")"
    else
      "func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\tres_map := make(map[string]gopurs_runtime.Value)\n\t\t\tfor k, v := range " <> valName <> " { res_map[k] = gopurs_runtime.Box(v) }\n\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Record(res_map)\n\t\t}()"
toValue _ (TNamed anyT) mbTast valName | (anyT == "any" || anyT == "interface{}") && isForeign mbTast = "gopurs_runtime.Any(" <> valName <> ")"
toValue dataDecls (TNamed anyT) mbTast valName | anyT == "any" || anyT == "interface{}" =
  let
    resolvedTast = map (resolveNewtype dataDecls) mbTast
  in
    case resolvedTast of
      Just (Record (Row fields tail)) | isClosedRowTail tail ->
        let
          fieldStr = map
            ( \(Tuple fK fT) ->
                "\t\t\t\tres_map[\"" <> fK <> "\"] = " <> toValue dataDecls (TNamed "any") (Just fT) ("_raw[\"" <> fK <> "\"]")
            )
            fields
        in
          "func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t_raw := gopurs_runtime.RecordToMap(gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> valName <> "))\n\t\t\tres_map := make(map[string]gopurs_runtime.Value)\n" <> String.joinWith "\n" fieldStr <> "\n\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Record(res_map)\n\t\t}()"
      Just f@(Func _ _) ->
        let
          fArgs = flattenFuncArgs f
          arity = Array.length fArgs
          genWrap remaining depth =
            if remaining == 0 then
              let
                castArgs = String.joinWith ", " (Array.replicate arity "any")
                castType = "func(" <> castArgs <> ") any"
                invokeArgs = Array.mapWithIndex
                  ( \i argT ->
                      let
                        pName = "p" <> show (depth - arity + i)
                      in
                        case argT of
                          Func _ _ ->
                            let
                              cbArgs = flattenFuncArgs argT
                              cbParams = Array.mapWithIndex (\ci _ -> "cb_arg" <> show ci) cbArgs
                              cbParamsDecl = String.joinWith ", " (map (\n -> n <> " any") cbParams)
                              applyChain = Array.foldl (\acc a -> "gopurs_runtime.Apply(" <> acc <> ", gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> a <> "))") pName cbParams
                            in
                              "func(" <> cbParamsDecl <> ") any { return " <> applyChain <> " }"
                          _ -> "gopurs_runtime.Unbox[any](" <> pName <> ")"
                  )
                  fArgs
                invokeCall = "fn(" <> String.joinWith ", " invokeArgs <> ")"
                -- Box preserves runtime closures and adapts native curried functions.
                fallbackChain = Array.foldl (\acc p -> "gopurs_runtime.Apply(" <> acc <> ", " <> p <> ")") ("gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> valName <> ")") (Array.mapWithIndex (\i _ -> "p" <> show (depth - arity + i)) fArgs)
              in
                "func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\tif fn, ok := " <> valName <> ".(" <> castType <> "); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> invokeCall <> ")\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn " <> fallbackChain <> "\n\t\t\t}()"
            else
              let
                currArg = "p" <> show depth
              in
                "gopurs_runtime.Func(func(" <> currArg <> " gopurs_runtime.Value) gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\treturn " <> genWrap (remaining - 1) (depth + 1) <> "\n\t\t})"
        in
          genWrap arity 0
      _ -> "gopurs_runtime.Box(" <> valName <> ")"
toValue _ typ _ valName = boxScalar typ valName

-- Workers box their native return directly, except for callbacks and arrays.
-- Their array path deliberately keeps the generic Box convention.
workerReturn :: Array DataDecl -> ExprType -> Maybe TypeNode -> Array String
workerReturn dataDecls tast = case _ of
  Nothing -> [ "\treturn gopurs_runtime.Value{}" ]
  Just t -> case t of
    TFunc _ _ ->
      let
        wrapped = toValue dataDecls t (getTastReturnType tast) "go_res"
        indented = String.replaceAll (Pattern "\n") (Replacement "\n\t") wrapped
      in
        [ "\treturn " <> indented ]
    TArray elem | not (isRuntimeValueNode elem) ->
      [ "\tout := make([]gopurs_runtime.Value, len(go_res))"
      , "\tfor i, v := range go_res { out[i] = gopurs_runtime.Box(v) }"
      , "\treturn gopurs_runtime.Array(out)"
      ]
    _ -> [ "\treturn gopurs_runtime.Box(go_res)" ]

isForeign :: Maybe ExprType -> Boolean
isForeign (Just (ADT "Foreign.Foreign" _ _)) = true
isForeign _ = false

isForeignArray :: Maybe ExprType -> Boolean
isForeignArray (Just (Array t)) = isForeign (Just t)
isForeignArray _ = false

isOpaqueType :: Maybe ExprType -> Boolean
isOpaqueType (Just (ADT _ _ _)) = true
isOpaqueType _ = false

-- Historical callbacks return the Effect thunk explicitly. Only ordinary Go
-- results request its execution inside the adapter.
nativeCallbackResult :: Maybe TypeNode -> Boolean
nativeCallbackResult (Just (TFunc _ _)) = false
nativeCallbackResult (Just (TNamed "any")) = false
nativeCallbackResult (Just (TNamed "interface{}")) = false
nativeCallbackResult (Just (TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value")) = false
nativeCallbackResult _ = true

module Gopurs.ModuleBindings
  ( TcoBindingGroup
  , prepare
  , declarations
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (fromArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.EffectExprs as EffectExprs
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, TranslateExpr, wrapInStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoType(..), sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (adtPayloadTypes, boxGoExpr, getUnboxedADT)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.ModuleWorkers as ModuleWorkers
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.NativeRecordArgs (workerArguments)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Typed))

type TcoBindingGroup =
  { recursive :: Boolean
  , bindings :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr)
  }

-- Analyze recursion before publishing the native signatures used by calls.
prepare :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> BackendModule -> { bindings :: Array TcoBindingGroup, functions :: ModuleFunctions }
prepare metadata modNameStr mod =
  let
    Tuple _ tcoBindings = foldl
      ( \(Tuple env acc) group ->
          let
            neBindings = fromArray group.bindings

            env' = case neBindings of
              Just ne | group.recursive -> Tco.topLevelTcoEnvGroup mod.name ne <> env
              _ -> env
            tcoBinds = map
              (\(Tuple id val) -> Tuple id (Tco.analyze env' val))
              group.bindings
          in
            Tuple env' (Array.snoc acc { recursive: group.recursive, bindings: tcoBinds })
      )
      (Tuple [] [])
      mod.bindings

    moduleFunctions :: ModuleFunctions
    moduleFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      ( \group ->
          if group.recursive then
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple _ val) -> extractUncurriedAbs val) group.bindings
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just _ -> map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
                Nothing -> map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (boxedSignature modNameStr name)) group.bindings
          else
            map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
      )
      tcoBindings
  in
    { bindings: tcoBindings, functions: moduleFunctions }

boxedSignature :: String -> String -> FunctionInfo
boxedSignature modNameStr name =
  { reference: SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)), fArgs: [], fRet: TypeValue, arity: 0 }

-- Syntax fixes worker arity. A computation between lambdas leaves a boxed
-- function result; fully consumed native sums use their specialized ABI.
-- Read-only record projections are selected here and reused by ModuleWorkers.
bindingSignature :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> Tuple Ident TcoExpr -> Tuple String FunctionInfo
bindingSignature metadata modNameStr (Tuple (Ident name) value) =
  let
    fallback = boxedSignature modNameStr name
    toGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
    signature = case extractUncurriedAbs value of
      Just { args, body } ->
        let
          annotation = extractFuncType value
          parameters = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } -> workerArguments toGoType args body
              (Array.take (Array.length args) fArgs)
              (if Array.length args < Array.length fArgs then Any else fRet)
              <> Array.replicate (Array.length args - Array.length fArgs) TypeValue
            Nothing -> Array.replicate (Array.length args) TypeValue
          result = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } | Array.length args >= Array.length fArgs ->
              workerResultType toGoType fRet
            _ -> TypeValue
        in
          fallback
            { fArgs = fromMaybe parameters (ListFilter.workerArguments metadata (Array.zip args parameters) result value)
            , fRet = result, arity = Array.length args }
      Nothing -> fallback
  in
    Tuple (sanitizeName name) signature

-- The ordinary native sum ABI intentionally boxes non-record payloads. For a
-- Tuple containing an array or an ADT pointer this would copy those payloads
-- merely to return them to a concrete caller, which immediately unboxes them.
-- The instantiated pointer layout is already established by the TAST and ADT
-- metadata. Publish that same layout to callers and retain the canonical box
-- only in the public getter. No body-specific or consumer-name rule is needed.
workerResultType :: (ExprType -> GoType) -> ExprType -> GoType
workerResultType toGoType result =
  let native = toGoType result
  in case native, getUnboxedADT result of
    TypeStructPointer pointer, Just (Tuple "Data.Tuple.Tuple" _)
      | Array.any erasedCompositeSlot pointer.typeArgs -> native
    _, Just (Tuple adtName adt) -> TypeStructValue adtName (adt.signature (adtPayloadTypes toGoType result))
    _, Nothing -> native
  where
  erasedCompositeSlot = case _ of
    TypeNativeArray _ -> true
    TypeStructPointer _ -> true
    _ -> false

-- Declarations and loop bodies share the same child translator as local
-- bindings. Each recursive group publishes its function declarations together.
declarations :: TranslateExpr -> CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> ModuleFunctions -> Array TcoBindingGroup -> Array GoDecl
declarations translate metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions groups =
  Array.concatMap
    ( \group ->
        let
          recVars = if group.recursive then map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> sanitizeName name) group.bindings else []

          context = { metadata, codegenStateRef, depth: 0, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions, bound: Map.empty, tcoIdent: Nothing, loopCtx: [], options: { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType: Nothing, mbExpectedGoType: Nothing }

          processBindingGroup :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> Array GoDecl
          processBindingGroup binds =
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val: val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) binds
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just fns ->
                  map (ModuleWorkers.declaration translate context (group.recursive && Array.length group.bindings == 1)) fns
                Nothing ->
                  Array.concatMap
                    ( \(Tuple (Ident name) expr) ->
                        let
                          bindingContext = context { depth = 0, bound = Map.empty, tcoIdent = (Just (sanitizeName name)), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = (Just (annotationType expr)) }
                          res = case EffectExprs.wrapCachedInt translate bindingContext 0 expr of
                            Just cached -> cached
                            Nothing -> translate bindingContext 0 expr
                        in
                          [ GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name), expression: wrapInStmts [] res.stmts TypeValue (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res.expr res.exprType), goType: TypeValue } ]
                    )
                    binds
        in
          if group.recursive then
            processBindingGroup group.bindings
          else
            Array.concatMap (\b -> processBindingGroup [ b ]) group.bindings
    )
    groups

-- Cached values use only an outer annotation, not primitive-result inference.
annotationType :: TcoExpr -> ExprType
annotationType (TcoExpr _ (Typed ty _)) = ty
annotationType _ = Any

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract the actual generated MeasureBatch callback conversion without execution."""
import hashlib,re
from pathlib import Path


def extract_callback_adapter(build):
 output=Path(build).resolve()/'output'
 matches=[]
 for path in sorted((output/'purescript').rglob('*.go')):
  text=path.read_text()
  if 'func Bench_MeasureBatch_runEffectWorker(' not in text:continue
  worker=text.split('func Bench_MeasureBatch_runEffectWorker(',1)[1]
  match=re.search(r'\bgo_arg2\s*:=\s*(.*?)\n\s*go_action\s*:=\s*Bench_MeasureBatch\(go_arg0,\s*go_arg1,\s*go_arg2\)',worker,re.S)
  if match is None:raise ValueError('Cannot extract exact generated MeasureBatch callback conversion')
  imports=re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+"gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"',text)
  if len(imports)!=1:raise ValueError('Cannot identify generated runtime import alias')
  expression=match[1].strip()
  normalized=re.sub(r'\b'+re.escape(imports[0])+r'\.', 'r.',expression)
  source='func convertCallback(arg2 r.Value) func() int {\n go_arg2 := '+normalized+'\n return go_arg2\n}\n'
  matches.append({'source':source,'generated_expression':expression,'generated_source':str(path),'generated_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'adapter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),'normalization':'Only the runtime import alias is normalized to r; the callback expression is copied literally.'})
 if len(matches)!=1:raise ValueError('Expected one generated MeasureBatch worker: '+str(len(matches)))
 return matches[0]

parser.add_argument('proof', type=Path)
parser.add_argument('--callbacks', action='store_true', help='Also check the exact generated FFI conversion and its metadata-free fallback')
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
output = (args.build / 'output').resolve()

texts = {p: p.read_text() for p in sources}
names = sorted({item['name'] for item in inputs})
owners = {}
for name in names:
    matches = [p.parent.relative_to(output).as_posix() for p, text in texts.items() if re.search(r'func Get_Test_' + name + r'_act\(', text)]
    assert len(matches) == 1, (name, matches)

original, text = opaque[0]

packages = sorted(set(owners.values()) | {original.parent.relative_to(output).as_posix()})
aliases = {p: 'p' + str(i) for i, p in enumerate(packages)}
imports = '\n'.join(f'{aliases[p]} "gopurs/output/{p}"' for p in packages)
actions = ','.join(f'"{name}":{aliases[owners[name]]}.Get_Test_{name}_act' for name in names)
boundary = aliases[original.parent.relative_to(output).as_posix()]
main = '''package main
import("encoding/json";"fmt";"os";r "gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"
IMPORTS
)
type Input struct{Name string `json:"name"`;Input int64 `json:"input"`}
func main(){var inputs []Input; f,e:=os.Open(os.Args[1]);if e!=nil{panic(e)};if e=json.NewDecoder(f).Decode(&inputs);e!=nil{panic(e)}
actions:=map[string]func()r.Value{ACTIONS}
for _,v:=range inputs{BOUNDARY.AuditInput=r.Int(v.Input);BOUNDARY.AuditCalls=0;out:=r.Apply(actions[v.Name](),r.Value{});if BOUNDARY.AuditCalls!=1{panic("expected one opaque call")};if out.Type!=r.TypeInt{panic("non integer")};fmt.Printf("%s %d %d\\n",v.Name,v.Input,out.IntVal)}}
'''.replace('IMPORTS', imports).replace('ACTIONS', actions).replace('BOUNDARY', boundary)
adapter = None
if args.callbacks:
    adapter = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('callback-adapter.py')))['extract_callback_adapter'](args.build)
    ordinary = 'if out.Type!=r.TypeInt{panic("non integer")};fmt.Printf'
    expanded = '''if out.Type!=r.TypeInt{panic("non integer")};
    action:=actions[v.Name]();_,native:=r.FunctionData[func() int64](action);metadata[v.Name]=native;
    for _,path:=range []string{"ffi_conversion","forced_fallback"}{
      chosen:=action;if path=="forced_fallback"{chosen=r.Func(func(_ r.Value)r.Value{return r.Apply(action,r.Value{})})}
      if _,hasNative:=r.FunctionData[func() int64](chosen);path=="forced_fallback"&&hasNative{panic("fallback unexpectedly has native metadata")};
      BOUNDARY.AuditCalls=0;callback:=convertCallback(chosen);converted:=callback();

      if int64(converted)!=out.IntVal{panic("FFI callback result differs")}
    };fmt.Printf'''.replace('BOUNDARY', boundary)
    assert ordinary in main
    main = main.replace(ordinary, expanded).replace('for _,v:=range inputs{', 'metadata:=map[string]bool{};for _,v:=range inputs{')
    main = main.rstrip()[:-1] + ';data,e:=json.Marshal(metadata);if e!=nil{panic(e)};if e=os.WriteFile(os.Args[2],data,0644);e!=nil{panic(e)}}\n' + adapter['source']

result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=output, env={**os.environ, 'GOWORK': 'off'}, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)

"""Pair frozen Go App/AppAll builds against the unchanged archived C medians."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
